title: Speeches
text:
A speech is a formal talk that a person gives to an audience. Good speakers usually start with a short story or a question to catch the attention of the listeners. After the introduction, they present their main ideas in a clear order. Most speeches end with a summary and a strong final sentence.

The purpose of a speech can be to inform, to persuade, or to entertain. A speaker who wants to persuade people uses facts and examples to support their opinion. Many speakers practise in front of a mirror before the event. When the speech is finished, the audience often shows its appreciation with applause.

options: They were bored by the speech
They wanted to leave the room
They did not hear the speech

paragraph_translations: Un discurso es una charla formal que una persona da a un público. Los buenos oradores normalmente empiezan con una historia corta o una pregunta para captar la atención de los oyentes. Después de la introducción, presentan sus ideas principales en un orden claro. La mayoría de los discursos terminan con un resumen y una frase final fuerte.

El propósito de un discurso puede ser informar, persuadir o entretener. Un orador que quiere persuadir a la gente usa datos y ejemplos para apoyar su opinión. Muchos oradores practican frente al espejo antes del evento. Cuando el discurso termina, el público suele mostrar su aprecio con aplausos.
